about_short_description.short_description: Getcho is a last-mile delivery platform. We connect retailers with last-mile fleets, making sure orders are delivered.

product.name: Getcho Same-Day Delivery Service
product.description: A platform for booking same-day local deliveries within a 25-mile radius, dispatching couriers to pick up and deliver goods promptly.

product.name: Getcho Shopify Integration
product.description: An integration that connects Getcho’s delivery platform with Shopify stores to enable local same-day delivery options directly within the Shopify checkout process.

product.name: Getcho Delivery Management Platform
product.description: A platform that manages the entire local delivery process including order verification, courier selection, pickup coordination, delivery monitoring, and confirmation.

identifier.value: Getcho Courier Communication and Tracking Tools

product.name: Getcho Courier Communication and Tracking Tools
product.description: Tools that provide real-time tracking, communication between couriers, businesses, and recipients, and delivery status updates.

identifier.value: Getcho Delivery Scheduling and Fleet Selection

product.name: Getcho Delivery Scheduling and Fleet Selection
product.description: A service that schedules deliveries based on customer availability and selects the optimal courier fleet balancing speed, cost, and payload requirements.
